merge_requests.title: Parse quantities from text and remove stock from bins
merge_requests.description:
Adds `FromStr` for `Quantity`, `Quantity::checked_sub` and `Ledger::remove`.

The README describes the library contract. Run `cargo test` offline.

merge_requests.label: limit
merge_requests.title: Limit quantities to one million items
merge_requests.description:
Adds `Quantity::LIMIT`, `Quantity::checked_mul` and `Quantity::needs_pallet`. Construction and arithmetic reject values above the limit.

The README describes the library contract. Run `cargo test` offline.

merge_requests.title: Add quantity totals

The README describes the library contract. Run `cargo test` offline.
